note: All five pieces are now 68-73, mean delta +4.8, and perf recovered while five builders each added structure: draw calls 123 -> 113, triangles 218k -> 203k, worst-case JS frame 7.3 -> 2.4 ms. Making the budget a standing constraint on every builder rather than one agent's task worked on its first outing. Two findings outrank the scores. (1) THE SILHOUETTE METRIC IS INVALID, not merely noisy: `separation` divides by within-species pose variance, so it is maximised by a smooth mirror-symmetric body and is actively PAID FOR by deleting appendages. The builder duly tucked the strawberry calyx inside the waist to clear the gate, and the shipped silhouette lost its only outline cue — five of six fruit now read as featureless ovals. The frozen suite fixed reproducibility; this is validity, and a metric that rewards the opposite of the goal is worse than no metric. (2) THE ENTIRE FLESH DELIVERABLE IS OFF ON THE SHIPPING CONFIGURATION: fleshCells is gated behind pxFade(c, 3.4), and portrait renders the cut face at 0.745x linear, pushing fwidth past the edge. Desktop gained flesh R 131.0 -> 150.6; portrait gained 93.8 -> 96.3, and its G/R went the WRONG way. Third portrait-only defect found so far.
